data.title: 萝丝 · 王座厅内的烛影沉思
data.description: 恢弘而清冷的王宫正殿内，已加冕为女王的萝丝独自倚坐在雕花王座上，佩剑竖立身侧，琥珀眼眸凝望着窗外夜空中的明月，思念着心中的少年。
data.location: grand royal throne room of Oriana Palace with marble columns and velvet carpets
data.action: seated regally on ornate golden throne holding rapier upright beside her knee, gazing softly at distant moon with fond longing
data.lighting: warm flickering candelabra flames casting regal shadows in the vast silent hall
data.mood: queenly burden, silent romantic longing, steadfast devotion to Shadow
data.promptProse: Sitting on an ornate golden throne with her rapier, blonde Queen Rose gazes toward the moon with gentle longing.
data.animaCaption: Queen Rose thinking of Cid in the quiet majesty of her throne room.
